text.formatted: A **stable** creature doesn't make death saving throws, even though it has 0 hit points, but it does remain Unconscious. The creature stops being stable, and must start making death saving throws again, if it takes any damage. A stable creature that isn't healed regains 1 hit point after 1d4 hours.
